_comment: teleport.c rloc_to_core() 1702-1716 from mon.c minliquid_core() 1074-1078: a teleport-capable monster in water relocates with RLOC_MSG, and a monster the hero spots only by telepathy while blind is still named in "X vanishes and reappears" (do_name.c x_monnam() tests canspotmon(), not canseemon()). A levitating Valkyrie with an amulet of ESP wishes a pool under herself, steps off it, puts on a blindfold, creates a giant eel (which lands in the pool) and, with the wizard-mode monpolycontrol option, polymorphs it into a tengu, which teleports out of the water on its next move. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
